  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const host = document.getElementById("scene");
    const loading = document.getElementById("loading");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer, scene, and camera
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      alpha: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;

    host.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xdde8df, 22, 58);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      42,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      120
    );

    const cameraTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.6, 0);

    let desiredTheta = 0.62;
    let desiredPhi = 1.12;
    let desiredRadius = 14.5;

    let theta = desiredTheta;
    let phi = desiredPhi;
    let radius = desiredRadius;

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural textures
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function makePaperTexture(baseColor, fiberColor) {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 256;
      canvas.height = 256;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      context.fillStyle = baseColor;
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);

      for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) {
        const x = Math.random() * 256;
        const y = Math.random() * 256;
        const length = 8 + Math.random() * 38;
        const angle = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35;

        context.strokeStyle = fiberColor;
        context.globalAlpha = 0.035 + Math.random() * 0.055;
        context.lineWidth = 0.4 + Math.random();
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(x, y);
        context.lineTo(
          x + Math.cos(angle) * length,
          y + Math.sin(angle) * length
        );
        context.stroke();
      }

      context.globalAlpha = 1;

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(2.2, 2.2);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      return texture;
    }

    function makeGroundTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 256;
      canvas.height = 256;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      context.fillStyle = "#74825e";
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);

      for (let i = 0; i < 1800; i++) {
        const shade = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 255 : 0;
        const alpha = 0.025 + Math.random() * 0.07;

        context.strokeStyle = `rgba(${shade}, ${shade}, ${shade}, ${alpha})`;
        context.lineWidth = 0.5 + Math.random();
        context.beginPath();
        context.moveTo(
          Math.random() * 256,
          Math.random() * 256
        );
        context.lineTo(
          Math.random() * 256,
          Math.random() * 256 + 12
        );
        context.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(30, 30);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      return texture;
    }

    const frontPaperTexture = makePaperTexture("#e9dfbd", "#9b8255");
    const sidePaperTexture = makePaperTexture("#d9b978", "#80602e");
    const groundTexture = makeGroundTexture();

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xf7fbef, 0x667254, 2.15));

    sun.position.set(-9, 15, 10);
    sun.castShadow = true;
    sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sun.shadow.camera.left = -15;
    sun.shadow.camera.right = 15;
    sun.shadow.camera.top = 15;
    sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -15;
    sun.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sun.shadow.camera.far = 42;
    sun.shadow.bias = -0.00025;
    sun.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    sun.target.position.set(0, 2, 0);
    scene.add(sun, sun.target);

    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xaecbd9, 0.85);
    fill.position.set(10, 6, -9);
    scene.add(fill);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const bambooMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xc99b35,
      roughness: 0.72,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const bambooLightMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xd8ad55,
      roughness: 0.76,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const bindingMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x5d401e,
      roughness: 0.88
    });

    const frontPaperMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: frontPaperTexture,
      roughness: 0.94,
      metalness: 0,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    const sidePaperMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: sidePaperTexture,
      roughness: 0.96,
      metalness: 0,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide
    });

    const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: groundTexture,
      color: 0xffffff,
      roughness: 1
    });

    const cloudMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xf7f5e9,
      roughness: 1,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.82,
      depthWrite: false
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function addRod(parent, start, end, radius, material, segments = 10) {
      const a = new THREE.Vector3(...start);
      const b = new THREE.Vector3(...end);
      const direction = b.clone().sub(a);
      const length = direction.length();

      const geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
        radius,
        radius,
        length,
        segments
      );

      const rod = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      rod.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      rod.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );
      rod.castShadow = true;
      rod.receiveShadow = true;

      parent.add(rod);
      return rod;
    }

    function addKnot(parent, position, radius = 0.075) {
      const knot = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(radius, 8, 6),
        bindingMaterial
      );
      knot.position.set(...position);
      knot.castShadow = true;
      parent.add(knot);
      return knot;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Meadow and distant landscape
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(80, 80),
      groundMaterial
    );
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = 0;
    ground.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(ground);

    const hillMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x829174,
      roughness: 1
    });

    const hillData = [
      [-13, -2.8, -25, 17, 5.5, 7],
      [5, -3.3, -29, 22, 6, 8],
      [19, -3, -24, 15, 4.5, 6]
    ];

    for (const [x, y, z, sx, sy, sz] of hillData) {
      const hill = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 18),
        hillMaterial
      );
      hill.position.set(x, y, z);
      hill.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
      hill.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(hill);
    }

    const clouds = [];

    function addCloud(x, y, z, scale) {
